rulings: Every canary here is a DESTINATION pool: the repair only ever moves a row ONTO its own parent slug, so each of these can gain rows and must never lose one.
No shardSlot: this lane is not sharded (the list is the scope), so SLOT must be left unset and the per-shard gate does not apply.

poolRows is the count MEASURED on 2026-09-05, not a hand-verified floor: other writers (the dedup cron, the rematch fleet) move these pools independently, so MODE=check can show a pool below it for reasons that have nothing to do with this lane. The GATE is the MODE=before / MODE=after pair captured around this lane's own apply -- that is the only comparison that attributes a change to this repair.
